reviews.title: My go to measure of my progress toward good health

For several years I have depended on the Charity Miles  for feedback on distance per workout and over periods of time.
I also value my miles bringing dedicated funds to my chosen charity.

reviews.title: Disappointed that I can’t see how much I’ve raised
reviews.text:
I really like this app. Yes, sometimes the mile tracking is off, but I haven’t run into that being too much of a problem, and I walk enough that if one walk isn’t recorded, so what?
I do wish I could see how much I’ve raised though. The first photo on this apps page shows someone looking at how much they’ve raised on the app, but it seems like they’ve gotten rid of that feature.
Without seeing how much I’m raising, I wonder if the money the app is making from the ads being run while I use it is even going to charity. It feels sketchy and being able to see how much you’ve raised would be a lot more motivating. I feel like this is an easy fix that would draw in a lot of people, and the fact that they had that option and took it away is odd to me.

reviews.title: Very inaccurate
reviews.text: This app's speed and distance tracking are astonishingly inaccurate. When a bargain bin smartwatch can tell I walked 2mi at 2.5mph, but Charity Miles says I only walked 0.10mi at 0.13mph...yeah. This is a great concept, but until the app is properly calibrated, there are much better ways to use your energy and effort for charity.

reviews.title: Charity Miles is a great app
reviews.text: I have used this great app almost everyday since Charity Miles started. I have walked over 5,000 miles in NYC and all over the USA and when I have traveled to Israel, Jordan, China, Ireland, Scotland, England, France, and Canada. It’s nice to know that I can walk with a purpose each and every day. I just put my cellphone in my pocket as I would anyway — and I turn on the app and charities benefit. Everyone should use Charity Miles — you are walking anyway.

reviews.title: Not a happy user
reviews.text: I and my husband started using Charity Miles when it first came out. We loved knowing all our walking was benefiting a worthy cancer charity. My husband has since lost his battle with cancer and I walk even more miles than before. Why am I not a happy user you ask? It is a consistent problem that I’m encountering and I’m really not happy with it. I walk all these miles and it doesn’t even log in! This is an ongoing problem and I’m ready to switch to another app.
